verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the backend is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes New Relic as a hosted SaaS: agents and OpenTelemetry forward data to New Relic, and pricing is based on ingest. Nothing documents a self-hosted deployment, its architecture, or an upgrade path, and one community comment points to an underserved on-premise APM market rather than a New Relic offering.
